entries.subject: [A13] ROB-8705: hook the method com.google.ccc.abuse.droidguard.DroidGuard.ssNative() to fix device incompatible error.
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: A13 base hook and both identical bundle-signature patches were compared with A16 runtime/jni/jni_internal.cc; A16 also clears JNI exceptions and scopes local references.
entries.rationale: A16 recognizes both authoritative A13 DroidGuard ssNative signatures and substitutes the matching empty-byte-array JNI function only for application UIDs when BstFilterAppsManager does not disable the hook. Source commits 224e3ead and e2917095 have the same parent and identical diff, so both historical patch identities map to the same final implementation without duplicating code.
entries.necessity: Required for the documented DroidGuard device-incompatible workaround while preserving the per-UID disable policy.
entries.performance: Adds string comparison and one policy lookup only when matching native methods are registered. The static decision is process-local and does not affect ordinary JNI calls beyond the name guard.
entries.security: Intentionally changes integrity-attestation behavior and is high-risk compatibility debt. Exact class/method signatures, application UID gating and privileged policy control must remain narrow.

entries.subject: [A13] Porting changes for abilist config.db entry (#2)
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: All six A13 diffs and final A13 SetupEnvironment were compared with A16 native_bridge.cc, native_bridge_lazy.cc and export map. A16 commit message records x86/x86_64 module build success; boot and translated-app runtime validation remain pending.
entries.rationale: A16 preserves the final A13 package-name export, abilist and xarch UID policy, Houdini CPU-info bind mounts, PMF preload and per-package before/after library hotfix hooks. It adapts the implementation to ART_TARGET_ANDROID, current linker namespaces and the Houdini 16 canonical cpuinfo path, and forwards bst_nbpname through the lazy native-bridge facade.
entries.necessity: Required for translated-app ABI reporting, emulator-detection compatibility, package-aware Houdini behavior and configured runtime hotfixes.
entries.performance: UID marker files are parsed during bridged environment setup, and PMF/hotfix libraries are initialized once per process. Library hooks wrap translated loads only for configured packages; translated-app startup latency remains a regression target.
entries.security: Loads privileged libraries from fixed /data/downloads paths and alters ABI/cpuinfo visibility. Marker ownership, SELinux labels, library integrity and Binder policy exports are security-critical. A16 fixes A13's partial pointer-sized file-buffer clearing by using bounded std::string reads.

entries.necessity: Required to prevent translated or malformed 64-bit stack metadata from aborting the guest during boot or unwinding.
entries.performance: No steady-state cost; only the already-failing lookup path changes log severity.
entries.security: Continuing after corrupt metadata can mask ART/compiler defects and weakens fail-fast behavior. Error telemetry and crash/unwind regression must ensure execution does not continue with unsafe state.

entries.subject: ROB-14898: Incorrect TimeZone of Iran
entries.author: Emin Huang
validation_evidence: system/timezone output version is 009.001|2025b|001; the bundled tzdata2025b Iran rules end at 2022 and contain no later DST rule.
entries.rationale: The two A13 commits have the same parent and identical hard-coded Asia/Tehran transition rewrite. Android 16 ships tzdata 2025b, whose Iran rules end DST after the September 2022 transition. Reapplying the parser workaround would duplicate authoritative data and could corrupt future timezone updates.
entries.necessity: Not necessary because current timezone data directly represents Iran's abolition of DST.
entries.performance: Avoids an extra Tehran-specific scan of every transition during timezone loading.
entries.security: Keeping timezone policy in signed/updateable tzdata avoids hidden libc behavior that can diverge from security and certificate time calculations.

entries.subject: [A13] Add property for arm-translator
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: A13 four-patch sequence was compared with final A16 system_property_set.cpp, SystemProperties Read/Get/ReadCallback/Update/Add and obs_str.hpp. x86/x86_64 libc build and ABI checks are recorded in target commits; runtime property oracle remains pending.
entries.rationale: A16 retains A13's per-app property hiding/faking, xprop UID lists, write suppression, callback handling, serial-to-length correction, missing-property reads and obfuscated ro.board.platform2 value. The A16 follow-up makes the legacy read declaration nullable so the implemented synthetic missing-property contract passes current Clang checks.
entries.necessity: Required for translated-app ABI reporting, anti-emulator compatibility, model overrides and protection of BlueStacks-specific properties.
entries.performance: Property reads are hot. Third-party lookups can inspect /proc and marker files, and obfuscated values add hashing/decryption. Property and app-start regressions must measure syscall and I/O cost; caching cannot ignore UID/package changes.
entries.security: This is a broad libc-level identity virtualization surface and blocks selected writes. Exact UID/package classification, marker ownership, buffer bounds and fail-open behavior are security-critical; synthetic values must not leak into system UIDs.

entries.subject: [A13] Add syscalls ioperm and iopl
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A16 target diff contains both syscall declarations and map exports for x86/x86_64; generated wrappers are build outputs rather than tracked source.
entries.rationale: A16 declares ioperm and iopl for x86/x86_64 in SYSCALLS.TXT and exports both symbols. Current bionic generates architecture assembly from that declaration, so obsolete generated A13 .S files are intentionally not hand-copied.
entries.necessity: Required by x86 runtime components that expect the legacy libc syscall wrappers.
entries.performance: No cost unless invoked; wrappers map directly to kernel syscalls.
entries.security: I/O privilege syscalls are highly privileged. Kernel capability and SELinux policy must deny untrusted applications even though libc exports the wrappers.

entries.subject: [A13] prop sync with real device and AOPS emulator
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: Final A16 system_property_set.cpp contains all three A13 property names/values and value != NULL guards at each writing branch.
entries.rationale: A16 includes the final A13 real-device property values for APEX, metadata encryption and Wi-Fi Direct, and guards every value-writing compatibility branch against a null output buffer.
entries.necessity: Required for application-visible device parity and to prevent null-buffer crashes in legacy property reads.
entries.performance: Adds three fixed-name comparisons on the already-gated third-party property path; null guards are negligible.
entries.security: Fakes security-relevant device properties for third-party applications. Values and caller classification must remain narrowly controlled and documented.

entries.subject: [A13] Return error when path is null in open function
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: Final A16 open.cpp contains the same guards in open and openat; no unrelated API entry point was changed.
entries.rationale: A16 preserves the A13 early -1 return for null pathname in variadic open and openat without altering the fortified entry points.
entries.necessity: Required by legacy callers that pass null and expect an error instead of a crash or lower-layer fault.
entries.performance: One predictable null check per open/openat call.
entries.security: Prevents a null dereference path. Existing technical debt: despite the A13 comment mentioning ENOENT, the guard does not set errno, so callers can observe stale errno; changing that is a separate compatibility decision.

entries.subject: [A13] linker: Allow text-relocs for x86 (only)
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Final A16 linker.cpp wraps only the enforcement/warning block with the i386 exception while retaining segment unprotect/relocate behavior.
entries.rationale: A16 preserves the A13 exception that allows text relocations only in 32-bit i386 while retaining the normal Android rejection and warnings on other architectures.
entries.necessity: Required for the documented legacy x86 FFmpeg/native libraries that still contain text relocations.
entries.performance: Text relocation processing occurs at library load and can increase startup time and dirty memory sharing.
entries.security: Weakens W^X/relocation hardening for 32-bit x86. The exception must remain architecture-scoped and legacy libraries should be rebuilt PIC where possible.

entries.subject: [A13] Prefer ipv4 over ipv6
entries.author: muzhong-bst
validation_evidence: Final A16 getaddrinfo.c sets PF_INET for unspecified family and issues T_A before T_AAAA.
entries.rationale: A16 retains A13's AF_INET default and A-before-AAAA query order when callers request an unspecified family.
entries.necessity: Required for App Player networks and applications where IPv6 resolution succeeds but IPv6 connectivity is unavailable or unreliable.
entries.performance: Can improve connection latency on IPv4-only paths but delays or suppresses optimal IPv6 use; dual-stack network regression is required.
entries.security: Changes address selection globally and can bypass IPv6-only policy expectations. DNS answers remain resolved through the normal net context.

entries.subject: Fd size (#10)
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final A16 fortify.cpp, poll.cpp and bionic_fortify.h contain the same process names, bounds and return behavior as A13.
entries.rationale: A16 retains the process-name-scoped FD_SETSIZE fortify relaxation and select fallback for Mobile Legends and Wild Rift, including the stricter eight-times-FD_SETSIZE ceiling.
entries.necessity: Required by the two documented game processes that pass oversized descriptors to fd_set/select code.
entries.performance: Reads /proc/self/cmdline on exceptional fortified FD operations and oversized select calls; ordinary descriptor paths are unaffected.
entries.security: High-risk semantic workaround: select can report one ready descriptor without updating fd sets, and Mobile Legends FD_ISSET can return true for an out-of-range descriptor. Scope must remain exact and runtime tests must watch busy loops and stale I/O assumptions.

validation_evidence: All 34 entries have A13 HEAD equal to the root gitlink and no post-gitlink branch delta; the four projects whose branch heads differ from root pointers are separately enumerated as real patch histories.
entries.rationale: These projects have no reachable android-13 tag or other defensible upstream baseline, and their checked-out HEAD equals the A13 root gitlink. entries.security: Prebuilt and custom snapshot identities must be pinned by SHA/hash and supplied through controlled sources. Lack of an upstream baseline is recorded, not hidden.

entries.subject: [A13] Updating build with required changes
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 build commit 04a5a80 records make a9966132 to 47f341a7 and soong 34839fc9 to 60366476; the audit continues through current child heads fa3b06f0 and e5cbcf04.
entries.rationale: The A13 build repository is a superproject. Init build establishes its child layout and 04a5a80 advances make and soong gitlinks. Android 16 tracks build/make and build/soong directly, so replaying the superproject objects would be incorrect; every child patch is enumerated separately from the recorded pre-update child SHAs through the child bst-v5.22.210 heads.
entries.necessity: The topology is necessary provenance but has no independent target runtime behavior.
entries.performance: No runtime or build-time cost; this decision prevents double replay of child changes.
entries.security: No superproject object is treated as proof that child content is present; child source patches retain independent review decisions.

entries.subject: Case ROB-18242 : adding calendar
entries.author: Build Master
validation_evidence: Target commit 6483acb67e removes the final A13 package set at the Android 16 product files and retains DeskClock.
entries.rationale: The two calendar commits are an add-then-replace sequence whose final A13 state selects DeskClock. Android 16 preserves that final state and the removal of Browser2, Calendar, Music, QuickSearchBox, BasicDreams, BluetoothMidiService, BuiltInPrintService, ManagedProvisioning, MmsService, HTMLViewer and EmergencyInfo.
entries.necessity: Required to retain the BlueStacks guest package surface and avoid duplicate or unsupported system applications.
entries.performance: Reduces image size, package scanning and background services; no hot-path overhead.
entries.security: Reduces the preinstalled application surface. CalendarProvider remains because other applications may depend on its provider contract.

entries.subject: [A13] add vndservicemanager and vndservice to the vendor partition (#8)
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Built installed-files.txt contains /system/vendor/bin/vndservice, /system/vendor/bin/vndservicemanager and its init rc.
entries.rationale: A13 made vndservice and vndservicemanager unconditional globally. Android 16 keeps upstream shipping-API policy and selects vndservicemanager only for the Windows android_x86_64 product; its dependency installs vndservice. This preserves the required guest behavior without changing every A16 product.
entries.necessity: Required by legacy vendor Binder services used by the BlueStacks Windows guest.
entries.performance: Starts one required service-manager process only on the target product.
entries.security: Narrower than A13: the legacy vendor service manager is not added to unrelated Android 16 products.

entries.subject: [A13] Allow building modules outside of android dir
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Current Soong finder lists hd and gated goldfish Android.mk inputs; build/make commit 2872af3a restores strict outside-include errors.
entries.rationale: A13 relaxed core/binary.mk path handling globally to build out-of-tree modules. Android 16 discovers only the explicit BlueStacks Android.mk files through Soong and retains platform path validation; restoring the broad Make relaxation would increase drift and hide bad include paths.
entries.necessity: The broad relaxation is unnecessary because all required external modules are explicitly discovered and current target builds pass.
entries.performance: Retaining strict path checks has no runtime cost and avoids ambiguous incremental dependencies.
entries.security: Strict source/output boundaries reduce accidental reads from arbitrary host paths during builds.

validation_evidence: Built installed-files.txt records /system/vendor/lib/libwvdrmengine.so and the output file exists at 1,250,188 bytes. Runtime DRM playback remains in the final boot gate.

entries.performance: Adds one shared library to the image; no cost until a DRM client loads it.

entries.subject: [A13] Update bluestacks-market keys
entries.author: Aaron He

entries.performance: No runtime performance impact.
entries.security: Private keys must be rotated and injected from controlled secret storage. Only public identity/hash provenance belongs in project documentation.

entries.necessity: Required for host-controlled display density and launcher/layout compatibility.
entries.performance: One boot-time property assignment; no rendering-loop overhead.
entries.security: The host value must remain validated because extreme density values can make UI inaccessible.

entries.subject: [A13]ROB-11904: Support DRM widevine
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng libcrypto built successfully with -j8.
readelf confirmed both legacy wrappers and both mgf1 implementations in 32-bit and 64-bit libcrypto.so.
64-bit libcrypto.so SHA-256 7f11cd19aec160bb2d9a1bddaf6303b164db234aa742f92d8d13c8a21b699a31; 32-bit SHA-256 d19038344bd55f4e3a38e7a789e653cb0cf42346f0e3aac5667a6bff4a13bb6d.
Component commit 3408a53df9dfc88f18405e3d22a4cd5b92654282 and root commit 53333c898c30bad7455c3192329846d8ec209af9 record the port. Runtime DRM playback remains in the final boot gate.
entries.rationale: Android 16 headers retained the legacy RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_PSS and RSA_verify_PKCS1_PSS declarations but the main libcrypto binaries exported only the mgf1 forms. The port restores both entry points as eleven lines of thin wrappers that pass a null MGF1 digest to the existing implementations, matching the A13 Widevine ABI without duplicating cryptography.
entries.necessity: Required for Widevine or other legacy guest binaries that resolve the non-mgf1 RSA-PSS symbols from the platform libcrypto ABI.
entries.performance: One extra function call on the two legacy entry points. Compiler-generated wrappers are 11-56 bytes and delegate immediately; cryptographic cost and algorithm selection are unchanged.
entries.security: No new algorithm or validation path is introduced. The wrappers use the established BoringSSL default MGF1 digest behavior; future BoringSSL API removals must trigger symbol-level revalidation.

entries.subject: Adding android - cts -master
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 tracks 896 files below the reviewed mustpass paths, while AOSP16 and Android-16 each track the same 165-file current layout.
Android-16 external/deqp HEAD 250bcc254 is a 25Q4 snapshot and its history includes the upstream Vulkan CTS 1.4.1 merge.
Android-16 OpenGL runners and Vulkan README/CMake references resolve to mustpass/main; no build reference to the removed A13 vk-master-2022-03-01 or mustpass/master paths was found.
entries.rationale: All seven A13 commits import generated CTS/OpenGL CTS/Vulkan CTS mustpass lists from 2019 through 2022. Android 16 carries the current upstream layout under mustpass/main, including the 25Q4 roll and Vulkan CTS 1.4.1 integration. Its runners, README and Vulkan CMake files reference main rather than the removed A13 master snapshot paths. Restoring those old paths would create stale parallel test inventories rather than preserve BlueStacks product behavior.
entries.necessity: Not necessary for the guest runtime or build. Current conformance data must stay aligned with the Android 16 dEQP binaries and test harness.
entries.performance: Avoids packaging and indexing hundreds of obsolete generated test-list files. There is no runtime performance effect because these are conformance-test inputs.
entries.security: Using the current upstream lists avoids false conformance results caused by pairing old case inventories with newer Vulkan/OpenGL test executables.

entries.subject: ROB-14898: Incorrect TimeZone of Iran (#1)
entries.author: emin-bst
validation_evidence: Both A13 commits are identical siblings of 55c400a0 and implement the same hard-coded timestamp truncation.
Android-16 tzdata version 009.001|2025b|001 already ends Iran DST rules after 2022, matching the bionic timezone audit.

The apparent Tehran code in the AOSP16 reference checkout is an uncommitted working-tree change (git blame reports Not Committed Yet), was treated as non-baseline evidence and was not modified or used.
entries.rationale: The two A13 commits have the same parent and identical code that truncates Asia/Tehran transitions at September 2022 and bypasses ICU final-rule processing. Android 16 uses tzdata 2025b, which already encodes Iran's abolition of DST after 2022. Reapplying the parser workaround would duplicate policy outside tzdata and can discard legitimate future transition metadata.
entries.necessity: Not necessary with the current signed/updateable timezone data. The final timezone result, not the old parser hook, is the requirement.
entries.performance: Avoids Tehran-specific array scans, copies and allocations during timezone construction.
entries.security: Keeps civil-time policy in updateable tzdata rather than hidden Java special cases that can diverge across native and Java consumers, certificates, logs and scheduling.

entries.subject: Build xmllint for data recovery
entries.author: muzhong-bst

entries.rationale: The A13 Android.mk-only xmllint target is represented in Android 16 by converting the maintained Soong xmllint module from host-only to host-supported target binary. Current libxml2 sources do not require the old sys/timeb compatibility workaround.
entries.necessity: Required by guest data-recovery XML inspection tooling.
entries.performance: Adds a 101320-byte utility to system/bin and no resident process or boot-time work.
entries.security: Uses current libxml2 source and build flags instead of reviving an old makefile and compatibility macro; exposure is limited to the command-line binary already selected by product packaging.

entries.subject: [A13] Disabling selinux
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 source patch and final AOSP16/Android-16 enabled.c were compared; both Android 16 trees use normal selinux_mnt detection. Existing promotion records include SELinux APEX boot closure without this patch.
entries.rationale: A13 forced libselinux is_selinux_enabled() to return false globally. Known-good AOSP16 and Android-16 retain normal mounted-policy detection, and the promotion has already closed SELinux/APEX boot blockers without disabling enforcement. Reapplying this patch would make userspace mis-detect policy state and bypass security initialization rather than solve a current compatibility gap.
entries.necessity: Not necessary on the validated Android 16 baseline and explicitly contrary to current security requirements.
entries.performance: The forced return saves only a trivial mount-state check; any boot-time benefit is negligible.
entries.security: Critical negative impact: globally reports SELinux disabled, can suppress labeling/policy-aware behavior and hides enforcement state from components. It must not be promoted.

entries.subject: Merge pull request #1 from allen-bst/gp-crash-skia
entries.author: henry-bst
validation_evidence: Both merge parents are preserved in this ledger entry and the audit compares the resulting final A13 component tree against Android 16.
entries.rationale: The merge records branch integration topology. Its resulting files are covered by the frozen final-A13 file comparison, while each non-merge product patch has a separate ledger entry and disposition.
entries.necessity: The final merged state is necessary; replaying the historical merge object itself across Android releases is neither required nor meaningful.

entries.security: No merge commit is used to waive a final-file mismatch; security-relevant final content remains assigned to the patch and file evidence entries.

entries.subject: [A13] Fixed crashes for various apps such as GP, Instagram, Facebook, Settings,and others.
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: A13 GrDrawOpAtlas allocation and current AtlasTypes Plot allocation paths were compared; target commit 0b9c6137 modifies both dataAt and prepForRender lazy allocations. Graphics runtime regression remains pending.
entries.rationale: A13 added trailing atlas storage to tolerate a goldfish glTexSubImage2D encoder over-read. In current Skia the Plot allocation moved to AtlasTypes.cpp. Android 16 allocates fBytesPerPixel * fWidth * (fHeight + 1) in both lazy allocation paths, preserving the root fix and covering a full extra row instead of A13's format-dependent fWidth-byte margin.
entries.necessity: Required to prevent intermittent out-of-bounds reads and crashes in Play Store, Instagram, Facebook, Settings and other atlas-heavy applications when using goldfish-opengl-pie.
entries.performance: Adds one zeroed row per allocated atlas Plot. Memory overhead is bounded by plot width and bytes per pixel; no additional per-draw computation beyond the allocation-size arithmetic.
entries.security: Prevents out-of-bounds reads by the graphics encoder. The larger full-row margin is safer across multi-byte color formats than the original byte-only margin.

entries.subject: Ffmpeg fix3 (#3)
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final media_codecs_ffmpeg.xml is exact; extractor and SoftFFmpegAudio have complete line evidence; target commit 6462e1ed contains the A16 adaptation.
entries.rationale: The four A13 patches evolve codec XML registration and FFmpeg extractor/audio behavior for Instagram/Facebook reels and Duolingo sound. Android 16 preserves the final XML exactly and all surviving extractor/audio lines while adapting to the A16 media APIs.

entries.author: Xin Li
validation_evidence: A13 final is 0de3cb2 with 129 files; AOSP16 and Android-16 use newer c1f2ae5/24a4c6e snapshots with 130 files.
entries.rationale: This is an Android 12 automerger snapshot, not a BlueStacks behavioral delta. Android 16 carries a newer 130-file upstream repository; replacing it with the A13 129-file snapshot would downgrade source and metadata.
entries.necessity: Not necessary; current upstream library content is authoritative for Android 16.
entries.performance: Avoids reverting later image-decoding and view fixes.
entries.security: Retains later upstream fixes and current platform metadata rather than an old bulk snapshot.

entries.subject: Sync to aosp-android-13.0.0_r49
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 HEAD is based on the Android 13 r49 synchronization; AOSP16 and Android-16 are corresponding 25Q4 snapshots with matching current file counts and layout.
entries.rationale: This commit is an Android 13 upstream synchronization containing generated Vulkan headers, CTS lists and generated LLVM tables rather than a BlueStacks product delta. Android 16 carries a substantially newer 25Q4 SwiftShader snapshot, including the Vulkan CTS 1.4 generation. Reapplying the A13 snapshot would downgrade generated interfaces and compiler tables as a single inconsistent block.
entries.necessity: Not necessary; Android 16 must retain its release-matched SwiftShader revision.
entries.performance: Avoids replacing newer compiler and rasterizer code with older generated LLVM data, which could regress Vulkan correctness and performance.
entries.security: Keeping the release-pinned upstream version preserves later validation and compiler fixes; generated headers must match their implementation revision.

entries.subject: [A13] deinit third_party/llvm-project
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: git ls-files -s third_party/llvm-project returns no entry in A13 final, AOSP16 or Android-16.
entries.rationale: A13 removed the third_party/llvm-project gitlink. Neither AOSP16 nor Android-16 tracks that submodule in the final SwiftShader repository, so the desired absence is preserved without a target-only commit.
entries.necessity: Required to avoid an unused nested repository and ambiguous LLVM source selection.
entries.performance: Reduces checkout size and submodule initialization work; no runtime impact.
entries.security: Removes an independently pinned code source that could drift from the SwiftShader release revision.

entries.subject: Using LFS to track big objects
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Android-16 .gitattributes marks current Vulkan master lists for LFS and git lfs ls-files reports vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt; AOSP16 has the same current layout.
entries.rationale: The final A13 intent is to keep oversized regression lists as LFS data. Android 16 retains LFS attributes and an LFS object for the current vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt. The old pipeline.txt no longer exists in the newer test-list layout and must not be restored from a different SwiftShader revision.
entries.necessity: Necessary only as repository storage metadata for current large test lists, not as a request to preserve obsolete A13 file names.
entries.performance: Reduces Git clone/object pressure for large generated lists; no guest runtime cost.
entries.security: LFS object availability must be checked before conformance builds so pointer text is not mistaken for a populated test list.

entries.subject: Remove some large files
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 history shows 9c8b7237 deleting both files and 9545e8ab restoring both as LFS objects.
entries.rationale: A13 temporarily deleted pipeline.txt and vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt only to restore both in the immediately later LFS commit. The deletion is not the authoritative A13 final state.
entries.necessity: Not necessary because reproducing an intermediate deletion would contradict the final A13 repository state.
entries.performance: Repository-storage-only transition with no guest runtime effect.
entries.security: No runtime security effect; preserving final test data avoids silently reducing conformance coverage.

validation_evidence: All 34 entries have A13 HEAD equal to the root gitlink and no post-gitlink branch delta; the four projects whose branch heads differ from root pointers are separately enumerated as real patch histories.
entries.rationale: These projects have no reachable android-13 tag or other defensible upstream baseline, and their checked-out HEAD equals the A13 root gitlink. They are therefore frozen component snapshots, not enumerable post-root branch patches. Their files remain covered by final-tree inventory and AOSP16-to-Android-16 promotion evidence; no synthetic empty-tree patch is invented.
entries.necessity: The component snapshots may be necessary build/runtime inputs, but classifying every upstream file as a BlueStacks patch would be false provenance.
entries.performance: No target cost; this is an audit-boundary decision.
entries.security: Prebuilt and custom snapshot identities must be pinned by SHA/hash and supplied through controlled sources. Lack of an upstream baseline is recorded, not hidden.

entries.subject: Don't use YV12 color format for video decoding
entries.author: Chih-Wei Huang
validation_evidence: Final A16 SoftwareRenderer, ColorConverter, NuPlayer and module FLACExtractor implementations were compared to each A13 patch semantic.
entries.rationale: Android 16 retains the four final A13 compatibility behaviors at current paths: software rendering avoids the unavailable Mesa YV12 path, RGB565 conversion uses libyuv dithering, NuPlayer ignores frame-dimension values misreported as sample aspect ratio, and the modular FLAC extractor accepts legacy sample rates down to 100 Hz.
entries.necessity: Required for legacy video rendering, malformed media metadata and low-rate FLAC compatibility in App Player.
entries.performance: RGB565 conversion uses the existing libyuv conversion path; the remaining checks are bounded conditionals during format setup or extractor initialization.
entries.security: No new authority or IPC surface. Relaxing FLAC rate validation can expose more unusual streams to the decoder and remains part of media fuzz/regression scope.

entries.subject: [A13] always enable OMX plugin on bs (#18)
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final A16 OMXStore and SoftOMXPlugin code contains addUserPlugin, SP-HAL loading, unconditional App Player component retention and corrected dlsym diagnostics.
entries.rationale: A16 loads the property-selected custom OMX plugin through the SP-HAL namespace, preserves SoftOMX dlerror diagnostics, and keeps Google audio/video OMX components enabled for App Player. The final A13 policy deliberately makes the App Player condition unconditional.
entries.necessity: Required for BlueStacks FFmpeg/custom OMX codecs and for legacy codecs otherwise filtered by the platform first-API policy.
entries.performance: One additional plugin load and component enumeration occur during OMX store initialization; no per-frame overhead is introduced.
entries.security: The property supplies a library name, but loading remains constrained to the SP-HAL namespace. The property must remain privileged and untrusted path values must not be accepted.

entries.security: Avoids the reverted CHECK-based color-format assumption on a codec parameter path.

entries.subject: [A13] Disable CFI
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 commit rationale and all five old Android.bp paths were reviewed. AOSP16 head 07c99ac1840f and A16 head 2f98cd4347f9 both retain current CFI defaults, while the three old libstagefright paths are absent.
entries.rationale: The A13 workaround removed CFI because old x86 swcodec APEX packaging omitted sanitized libraries. The known-good AOSP16 reference and Android-16 target both retain the current CFI defaults; three of the five old module paths no longer exist and Codec2 now centralizes CFI-capable soft-codec defaults. Copying the deletions would reduce hardening and diverge from the verified A16 architecture.
entries.necessity: Not necessary at source level. The target-only build gate must still verify that com.android.media.swcodec contains its required x86 libraries.
entries.performance: Keeping CFI has a small indirect-call/check overhead but preserves platform hardening; removing it would trade security for an obsolete packaging workaround.
entries.security: CFI is an exploit-mitigation control. It must remain enabled unless a reproducible A16 packaging failure proves a narrowly scoped exception is required.

entries.subject: Setup FFMPEG audio/mpeg-L2 codec correctly
entries.author: Michael Goffioul

entries.rationale: The monolithic A13 FFmpeg patch is adapted to A16's split media/module and libstagefright layout. Media MIME/metadata contracts, FileSource probing, extractor/decoder integration, OMX wiring and the MPEG-L2 Google-codec guard are all retained.

entries.security: Substantially expands parser/decoder attack surface. FFmpeg libraries and extractors require fuzzing, malformed-input regression and prompt security updates.

entries.subject: [A13] add fps setting support
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final Scheduler reads bst.max_fps inside resyncToHardwareVsyncLocked; the five A16 commits record scheduler-path, propagation and lock-order fixes.
entries.rationale: The source feature was temporarily reverted and restored in A13. Android 16 implements the final bst.max_fps scheduler override on the validated resync path, propagates display changes, and avoids the recursive lock exposed during A16 adaptation.
entries.necessity: Required so post-data bst.max_fps changes affect SurfaceFlinger rather than remaining a dead property.
entries.performance: Property read and mode update occur on hardware-vsync resync/display changes, not per frame. Extra forced schedule updates can cause transient jank and require FPS regression.
entries.security: Property is privileged guest configuration; values are constrained by available display modes and do not expose a new IPC surface.

entries.subject: [A13] Added telephony related changes
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng telephony-common and FrameworksTelephonyTests built successfully in 08:20 with -j8.
telephony-common.jar SHA-256 cbe0980f420651ea3e733dc0cb8ea2b6869917ee2a00853d841173ac1b69ce39; FrameworksTelephonyTests.apk SHA-256 da9158e42a01caadb8c1c46d075c7241fecc7571f450994f95a3811c820c4ec6.

Component commit b06a887a526981cbc0b23fd2bf469334df9b9f9d and root commit f5ea05cd7f9bf5d7e2c1744d6b6c3390dec1236d record the omissions. Runtime subscriber and ICC serial checks remain in the final boot gate.
entries.rationale: The A13 telephony patch spans phone identity, virtual subscriptions, UICC readiness and subscriber information. Android 16 already contained the current-API ports for IMEI, virtual subscription and UICC behavior, but public subscriber-ID and ICC-serial calls still fell through to real PhoneSubInfo paths. Follow-up b06a887a restores those two final A13 fast paths behind the existing BST telephony gate.
entries.necessity: Required for a coherent virtual SIM identity: applications must observe the same host-provided subscriber and SIM serial values exposed by the rest of the promoted telephony stack.
entries.performance: Each affected call adds one feature-gate branch and either one property read or one existing utility lookup. Normal Android behavior has no additional work when the gate is disabled.
entries.security: The fast paths intentionally bypass normal subscriber-identifier permission checks only when the privileged BlueStacks telephony mode is active, matching A13. The feature gate and backing properties must remain inaccessible to untrusted applications.

entries.subject: [A13] Temp fix the audioserver crash issue
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 crash trace and one-line workaround were compared with the final Android-16 service startup sequence; no late ABinderProcess thread-count mutation remains. Audio runtime regression is pending.
entries.rationale: A13 stopped calling ABinderProcess_setThreadPoolMaxThreadCount(1) after the vndbinder pool had already started, preventing the fatal 'threadpool cannot be shrunk' assertion. The Android 16 service no longer has that conflicting NDK Binder call and configures a single 16-thread RPC pool before joining it, preserving the crash fix through the current service architecture.
entries.necessity: Required semantically: the audio HAL service must not shrink a running Binder pool. No A13 line should be copied because the obsolete API sequence no longer exists.
entries.performance: The current 16-thread pool can consume more stack memory than the old one-thread request but supports concurrent HAL traffic and is the Android 16 service design.
entries.security: Avoids an unauthenticated service abort path. Binder concurrency still requires thread-safe HAL implementations.

entries.subject: [A13] add fps setting support
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final Android-16 source contains libcutils linkage, refresh registration, synchronized one-second polling, atomic refresh-period publication and lock-safe callback delivery. Component commits ea0df662, fc6ad600 and bf800caa encode the implementation and safety follow-ups; runtime FPS regression remains pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 preserves the complete A13 FPS contract: read bst.max_fps, update the framebuffer vsync period, expose the new period through HWC2 display attributes and notify SurfaceFlinger through the refresh callback. Follow-up commits remove the unvalidated direct callback and restore it with null checks, mutex-protected state, atomic period publication, per-thread timing and callback invocation outside the lock.
entries.necessity: Required for host-configured frame-rate changes to affect framebuffer HWC timing and reach SurfaceFlinger.
entries.performance: One property read per second in the vsync thread. The callback runs only when the period changes; no per-frame property read is introduced. Very high/invalid FPS values are rejected when the computed period is non-positive.
entries.security: The privileged bst.max_fps property controls display scheduling. Parsing is bounded and callbacks are null-checked and invoked without holding the adapter mutex, reducing deadlock and crash risk.

entries.subject: [A13] Disabling default gralloc module
entries.author: Aaron He

Android 16 tracks the legacy gralloc sources but no Android.mk or Android.bp in modules/gralloc, so the module remains disabled without carrying an obsolete .orig file.
entries.necessity: Required to avoid building or selecting a second generic gralloc implementation alongside the external goldfish driver.
entries.performance: Avoids duplicate build output and prevents accidental runtime selection of the non-accelerated/default gralloc.
entries.security: Reduces graphics module ambiguity; the selected goldfish gralloc remains subject to its own ABI and buffer-validation review.

entries.subject: bst_hooks of Linux filesystem for supporting Linux 5.15 functionalities
entries.author: muzhong-bst
validation_evidence: Commit-level audit reports complete final line evidence for all files except fs/bst_hooks.h in ec3320cd, where partial evidence is expected because later A13 patches revise the same helper. The final header and implementation are present in kernel-a16.
Android-16 root tracks kernel-a16 10d61b7393ec37012e27530bf344c559da766590 on aosp16-bst-merge; eee2a2da is its AOSP16/A13 semantic merge commit.
entries.rationale: These A13 patches form the final Linux 5.15 BlueStacks filesystem hook layer, process/proc presentation, emulator-string filtering, app UID policy, ptrace/kallsyms restrictions, SELinux audit filtering and application-specific compatibility fixes. Android 16 uses kernel-a16; every surviving changed line maps to the corresponding final target file, with only the later A13 revisions winning where several commits touch bst_hooks.c.
entries.necessity: Required for the established guest filesystem contract, host path translation, application compatibility and intended process/device presentation.
entries.performance: Adds UID and path checks to selected VFS/proc/stat operations. A13 includes caching/optimized UID classification; final regression must watch syscall-heavy workloads and boot time.
entries.security: High-risk kernel surface: intentionally filters proc/device information and adds privileged path hooks. Bounds, user-pointer handling, recursion avoidance and privilege gates must remain covered by kernel review and runtime tests.

entries.subject: [A13] Update defconfig from Linux 5.15.104 to 5.15.119
entries.author: muzhong-bst
validation_evidence: All final config/boot hunks map to kernel-a16; e8368878 partial defconfig evidence is explained by later A13 defconfig commits and the final target config is compared at head.
entries.rationale: These commits establish the A13 x86_64 defconfig, boot init/default header, Tiramisu identification, NLS, virtualization/media options, disabled unused DRM/USB options and removal of empty prebuilt gitlinks. Android 16 kernel-a16 preserves the final semantic state and additionally enables SquashFS for system.sfs.
entries.necessity: Required for the android_x86_64 Windows board, bootloader contract and packaged system filesystem.
entries.performance: Configuration removes unused drivers and enables required virtualization/filesystem features, reducing irrelevant initialization while adding only selected kernel code.
entries.security: Kernel config defines attack surface. Disabled unused drivers reduce exposure; enabled virtualization, NLS, videobuf and SquashFS options must stay limited to required product functionality.

entries.subject: [A13] Changing default launcher package
entries.author: henry-bst
validation_evidence: Final A16 FallbackHome was reviewed through candidate enumeration, preferred activity registration, null handling and finish/retry behavior. Runtime clean-Data launcher validation remains mandatory.
entries.rationale: A16 removes the FallbackHome progress animation and, only when HOME resolves to ResolverActivity, selects the final A13 launcher package com.uncube.launcher3. The current implementation validates ResolveInfo/activityInfo, requires the preferred package to exist instead of choosing an arbitrary fallback candidate, and catches runtime failures.

entries.security: Settings uses privileged PackageManager authority to set the default HOME. Exact package matching prevents an unrelated launcher from becoming preferred when the intended package is absent.

entries.performance: No steady-state overhead. The failure path logs once and returns; the success path remains upstream behavior.
entries.security: Safer than the A13 unconditional bypass because Bluetooth keystore integrity/config processing remains enabled whenever Keystore2 is ready.

entries.subject: [A13] Added changes for faking Ethernet connnection as WiFi
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Final A16 EthernetConfigStore contains the gated static configuration and EthernetNetworkFactory tests cover legacy Wi-Fi presentation.
entries.rationale: A16 preserves both halves of the A13 patch: property-driven static IP/gateway/DNS configuration in EthernetConfigStore and Wi-Fi legacy presentation in EthernetNetworkFactory when bst.config.modify_network is enabled. Current dependencies and tests replace static property caching and old factory APIs.
entries.necessity: Required for host-managed guest addressing and applications that expect Wi-Fi rather than Ethernet APIs.
entries.performance: Property parsing occurs during config load/agent creation, not packet processing. Static addressing avoids DHCP but malformed values can delay or fail network bring-up.

entries.subject: ROB-16456: add etherNetType entry for freely switching between ethernet or wireless network type

entries.rationale: A16 queries BstFilterAppsService through the hidden ServiceManager reflection boundary and selects Ethernet only when isEtherNetType(system_server) is true; failures and null service default to Wi-Fi. Transport parsing is factored for the current tracker and covered by tests.
entries.necessity: Required to switch guest-visible transport between compatibility Wi-Fi and real Ethernet semantics without rebuilding.
entries.performance: One synchronous Binder query during network capability construction; no packet-path overhead. Service readiness can affect startup latency but failure is bounded and defaults safely.
entries.security: A privileged service controls system network presentation. Reflection does not widen Binder access, but service spoofing/readiness and fail-open Wi-Fi behavior require boot regression.

entries.subject: [A13] Added changes for creating BlueStacks wifi spot (#1)
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: A13 WifiServiceImpl fields and return paths were mapped to Android-16 BstWifiInfoProvider and service call sites; target commit 025929cf contains only the provider and current-service integration. Runtime WifiManager/DHCP/.ma regression remains pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 preserves every final A13 virtual-Wi-Fi output: enabled Wi-Fi/AP state, BlueStacks SSID, configured MAC/BSSID, connected supplicant state, guest IP, gateway, DNS and publication of .ma for libcore. The current API adaptation isolates construction in BstWifiInfoProvider, validates MAC and IPv4 properties, uses the configurable guest address and atomically stages the MAC file before rename.
entries.necessity: Required for applications that inspect WifiManager rather than the underlying Ethernet transport and for the libcore wlan0/MAC compatibility path.
entries.performance: Creates small WifiInfo/DhcpInfo objects on API calls and writes .ma only when the validated MAC changes. Synchronized publication and fsync add bounded first-call/change cost, not packet-path overhead.
entries.security: Properties control app-visible network identity and DNS. Invalid values fall back safely; .ma publication is atomic and world-readable as required by app-side NetworkInterface, so it must contain only the virtual MAC and the directory must remain system-controlled.

entries.subject: [A13] ROB-13598:Fix Device_Details apk get Wifi MacAddr not 02:00:00:00:00:00 issue
entries.author: henry-bst
validation_evidence: The final Android-16 getConnectionInfo path constructs the virtual WifiInfo before permission checks and returns wifiInfo.makeCopy(redactions), with local-MAC redaction cleared only by checkLocalMacAddressPermission.
entries.rationale: A13 explicitly replaced the virtual MAC with WifiInfo.DEFAULT_MAC_ADDRESS for callers lacking local-MAC permission. Android 16 feeds the virtual WifiInfo through the platform getApplicableRedactions and makeCopy(redactions) flow, clearing REDACT_FOR_LOCAL_MAC_ADDRESS only for callers with the same privileged permission. This preserves the final information-disclosure boundary using the current framework API.
entries.necessity: Required so ordinary applications see the protected default MAC while authorized diagnostics can obtain the configured virtual MAC.
entries.performance: Uses the normal WifiInfo redaction copy already required by Android 16; no extra I/O or Binder call.
entries.security: Prevents disclosure of the stable virtual MAC to callers without local-MAC permission and also retains current SSID/BSSID/location redactions.

entries.subject: [A13] Porting patch to fix adb not permitting push /mnt/windows/BstsharedFloder issue on hyperv
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: Final should_use_fs_config returns false for /mnt/windows/ before evaluating device API level; target commit 361c29e7 scopes this exception to that prefix. Shared-folder push regression remains pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 excludes /mnt/windows/ from fs_config before the current API-level branch, preserving A13 Hyper-V shared-folder push semantics on both old and current platform behavior. The /data and /sdcard exceptions remain limited to legacy API levels as required by upstream A16.
entries.necessity: Required so adb push does not apply Android image ownership/mode rules to the host-backed Windows shared filesystem, which rejects those operations.
entries.performance: One prefix check per sync path; avoiding unsupported metadata operations improves shared-folder transfers.
entries.security: ADB writes to the shared mount retain host-filesystem permissions rather than fs_config. Access still depends on the ADB command whitelist, shell UID, mount options and host path controls.

entries.subject: [A13] Port adb related changes & Drop adb privileges
entries.author: henry@bluestacks.com
validation_evidence: A13 adb.cpp/adb.h/file_sync_service.cpp/main.cpp were mapped to current Android-16 APIs; target commit 361c29e7 contains the bounded parser, both enforcement points and forced privilege drop. Runtime allowed/denied ADB command tests remain pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 preserves the final A13 command policy for OPEN services and sync paths, the bst.enable_adb_access override, comma-separated prefix/wildcard whitelist and unconditional adbd privilege drop. The current adaptation strips protocol NULs before checking, bounds input to 1024 bytes and 32 entries, trims tokens and fails closed when .adbcmd is absent or unreadable. This replaces an earlier AOSP16 fail-open approximation.
entries.necessity: Required to keep remote ADB restricted by default while allowing host-approved diagnostics and file operations, and to prevent adbd from retaining root due to ro.secure configuration.
entries.performance: When unrestricted ADB is disabled, each service/sync request opens and parses one small whitelist file. Bounds cap cost; heavy ADB workloads should be measured, but this is outside guest packet and application hot paths.
entries.security: Critical access-control boundary. Missing policy fails closed, command pointers are null-checked, parsing is bounded and adbd always drops to shell. Prefix and wildcard entries remain powerful and the policy file must be writable only by trusted host/system components.

entries.subject: BAPSPLAN-32: Implement a BroadcastReceiver to handle immediate download retry requests via an intent.
entries.author: wei-bst
validation_evidence: A13 commit 6be0a14 and target commit db61a3d were reviewed hunk by hunk. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; authorized and unauthorized broadcast tests remain pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 retains the host retry action, optional download-id filter, failed-connection reset, query and job rescheduling, plus the one-second override deadline. It moves the exported action out of the multi-purpose DownloadReceiver into RetryDownloadReceiver and validates the sender UID/advanced permission before accessing all-downloads state.
entries.necessity: Required for the host to wake downloads that are waiting for retry/network without waiting for platform backoff.
entries.performance: Work runs on the provider async handler, performs one bounded update/query over pending states and schedules only matching rows. It is action-triggered, not a polling path.
entries.security: Improves A13 by rejecting arbitrary exported-broadcast callers; only root, shell, system, the provider itself or holders of ACCESS_DOWNLOAD_MANAGER_ADVANCED may request retries.

entries.subject: [A13] Reading SimLocale info base on property
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Current PhoneInterfaceManager lines 8136-8149 implement the ordered persist.sys.locale/bst.locale path. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; runtime locale fallback remains pending.
entries.rationale: Android 16 first returns persist.sys.locale, then bst.locale, and only then runs the current upstream SIM-country locale resolution. This preserves the A13 no-SIM result while retaining current permission and telephony-feature checks and a functional platform fallback.
entries.necessity: Required because the virtual guest may not have modem-backed SIM records when locale is queried.
entries.performance: Two property reads precede the existing method; no additional Binder, database or network work.
entries.security: The current privileged permission and feature enforcement remain active, unlike the commented-out A13 tail.

entries.subject: [A13] rvc to a13 sync, changes include: 1. update ro.boot.hardware value same as ro.hardware prop 2. Using init.tiramisu.rc, instead init.<ro.hardwre>.rc 3. Using /ueventd.tiramisu.rc, instead /ueventd.x86.rc 4. Returning default fstab as /fstab.tiramisu

entries.performance: One failed standard fstab search followed by one existence check during boot.
entries.security: Keeps Android 16 canonical ueventd parsing and only adds deterministic board fallbacks.

entries.necessity: Required to preserve the A13 guest boot tolerance and diagnostics on the Windows board.
entries.performance: Service timing properties are gated; uevent logging is compiled in but INFO output is suppressed by the retained WARNING threshold.
entries.security: Permissive service fallback and writable kmsg remain explicit eng-build debt; no unsupported SCS flag is claimed for x86_64.

entries.subject: ROB-17586: Adding whitelist feature for su, and support OTA update for su whitelist. (#2)
entries.author: wei-bst
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 final su implementations were compared file by file; headers, utilities, daemon and rc are identical, and remaining source differences are formatting plus the current-compiler array declaration adaptation.

Android-16 commit 2e0a75a42df3f785c500711ddada805d70e07ff2 changes only the managed su module and carries the complete final source set. Target build and runtime authorization oracles remain part of the final regression gate.
entries.rationale: Android 16 preserves the final A13 managed-su implementation: signed OTA whitelist handling, package and command-line authorization, developer-mode hcall, denial reporting and the report daemon. Common implementation files are byte-identical or differ only by whitespace/line endings, except resolve_in_allowed_dirs uses an unsized array parameter to satisfy current Clang while preserving PATH_MAX behavior. The A13 unsafe-code removal remains present in the final source.
entries.necessity: Required to expose root only under the host-managed developer and signed-whitelist policy and to retain denied-request telemetry.
entries.performance: Authorization performs package lookup, whitelist parsing, signature hashing and hcall work only when su is invoked. Denial reporting uses a local datagram and does not block on cloud upload, but verbose warning logs and fallback package scans can add cost during repeated denied calls.
entries.security: High-privilege surface. Public-key verification, whitelist update ownership, command canonicalization, package-to-UID resolution and fail-closed behavior are security-critical. The report payload contains command, package, cwd and signature metadata and must remain protected by socket/SELinux policy.

entries.subject: ROB-17586: set the target output path to /system/xbin/
entries.author: wei-bst
validation_evidence: A13 Android.mk and Android-16 Android.bp were compared field by field; install_in_xbin is present and all functional sources and dependencies are represented.
entries.rationale: A13 selected TARGET_OUT_OPTIONAL_EXECUTABLES in Android.mk. Android 16 has no module-local Android.mk and expresses the same /system/xbin installation contract with install_in_xbin: true in Android.bp. The Soong target also carries every A13 source, HD static dependency, crypto/log dependency and report-daemon rc declaration.
entries.necessity: Required because callers and root tooling expect /system/xbin/su.
entries.performance: Build-system-only mapping with no runtime cost.
entries.security: Installation location does not grant privilege by itself; file mode, ownership, SELinux domain and managed authorization still require runtime verification.

entries.subject: Revert "Faking the uninitialised properties."
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Final properties.cpp in all three trees was inspected and contains the same immediate null return.
entries.rationale: The complete A13 revert is preserved by the unchanged Android-16 implementation: an absent prop_info returns the caller-provided default and never enters the read callback path.
entries.necessity: Necessary to represent the final A13 decision and prevent resurrection of the unsafe intermediate hook.
entries.performance: Restores the constant-time missing-property fast path.
entries.security: Keeps property spoofing out of generic libbase and avoids a null descriptor call; bionic remains the single reviewed virtualization boundary.

entries.subject: Faking the uninitialised properties.
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 commit 1d05b47e is an exact revert of 31bba9e8; final A13, AOSP16 and Android-16 all return default_value immediately for pi == nullptr.
entries.rationale: This intermediate A13 change called __system_property_read with a null prop_info so bionic could synthesize selected missing properties. A13 fully reverted it later the same day. The final authoritative libbase behavior is to return default_value when the property does not exist.
entries.necessity: Not necessary and contrary to final A13 behavior. Missing-property virtualization that remains required is implemented inside the reviewed bionic compatibility boundary.
entries.performance: Avoids extra stack buffers and a libc compatibility call for every missing property lookup.
entries.security: Avoids deliberately passing a null property descriptor across the libc API and keeps generic libbase callers on the documented default-value contract.

entries.subject: ROB-13448: Remove prng_seeder to improve boot time (#1)
entries.author: kitt-bst
validation_evidence: A13 and A16 Android.bp entries were compared directly. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; boot log/CRNG readiness verification remains pending.
entries.rationale: The current prng_seeder module inherits init_rc through rust_defaults; Android 16 comments out that current init_rc entry, preserving the A13 product behavior without deleting the binary or changing unrelated Rust dependencies.
entries.necessity: Required by the established App Player boot profile, which has no hardware RNG device expected by this early-init helper.
entries.performance: Avoids launching and scheduling one early-init service, matching the A13 boot-time objective.
entries.security: This removes supplemental persistent seed mixing, so release validation must confirm the kernel CRNG initializes and no service consumes weak randomness. It does not disable the kernel RNG or platform crypto APIs.

entries.subject: [A13] Enable bst sharefolders
entries.author: muzhong-bst
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 VolumeManager::start contain the same property write; target commit a19a66ff changes only this startup signal. Runtime shared-folder regression remains in the final boot gate.
entries.rationale: Android 16 imports SetProperty and sets bst.config.mountsf to 1 at the same VolumeManager::start phase as A13, before internal emulated-volume setup. AOSP16 lacks this A13-only requirement, so the explicit target port is necessary.
entries.necessity: Required to signal host/shared-folder mounting readiness for the guest integration path.
entries.performance: One property write during vold startup; no steady-state I/O cost.
entries.security: The property can activate a host-file sharing surface. SELinux property ownership and the consumer's path validation must prevent untrusted apps from spoofing or widening mounts.

entries.subject: fix Operation not supported on transport endpoint on vold
entries.author: allen-bst
validation_evidence: Android-16 SetQuotaInherit and SetQuotaProjectId explicitly return 0 with parameter suppression; target commit bf57a99 changes only Utils.cpp for this behavior. Full storage/runtime regression remains pending.
entries.rationale: A13 bypasses SetQuotaInherit and SetQuotaProjectId because App Player storage returns EOPNOTSUPP for project-quota ioctls. Android 16 preserves the exact success semantics with explicit no-op functions and removes the unreachable #if 0 blocks. AOSP16 lacks this A13-only workaround.
entries.necessity: Required so app-directory preparation does not fail on the virtual storage transport when project quotas are unavailable.
entries.performance: Avoids open and ioctl calls during app-directory creation and fixup, improving this path. It also disables project-quota accounting for the affected filesystem.
entries.security: Quota project IDs are not enforced by this layer, so storage isolation and abuse limits must come from the App Player storage backend and other Android controls. The no-op must remain scoped to this product tree.

entries.subject: Using LFS to track testdata
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: Android-16 .gitattributes and git lfs ls-files agree on exactly two current files; ledger comparison finds the A13 expected fixture contents retained or superseded in the current tree.
entries.rationale: A13 moved 16 then-large generated test artifacts to LFS. Android 16 retains the reviewed test artifacts and applies LFS only to the two outputs that remain large in the current upstream snapshot: large.code_coverage and large.verbose_cfg. Restoring old LFS attributes for now-small or regenerated files would add storage indirection without preserving behavior.
entries.necessity: Necessary as repository storage policy only for current large objects.
entries.performance: Keeps large clone objects out of normal Git while avoiding unnecessary LFS fetches for smaller fixtures; no guest runtime effect.
entries.security: LFS availability must be validated for tests, but these fixtures are not shipped in the guest image.

entries.subject: Adding tradefederation prebuilts : part 2
entries.author: Aaron He
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 ls-tree plus filegroups/tradefed/Android.bp were compared directly; the current module is absent by design.
entries.rationale: A13 added a 34 MB tradefed-test-framework.jar and a matching filegroup. The Android 16 prebuilt snapshot has removed both the file and filegroup; current test_harness consumes the consolidated current artifacts. Reintroducing the orphaned A13 JAR would not restore a live feature.
entries.necessity: Not necessary because no current module declares or consumes tradefed-test-framework-prebuilt.
entries.performance: Avoids 34 MB of duplicate repository and checkout storage.
entries.security: Avoids retaining an unreferenced old executable JAR with no current update path.
